name: M3_PPS170MI_UpdPlannedPO
description: Update planned purchase orders with the same capabilities as the interactive Planned Purchase Order.Open function (PPS171). Use this operation as the standard interface for integrations that modify planned purchase orders, instead of the older direct‑update operation UpdPOP. It updates a single planned purchase order identified by its planned order number and subnumbers and lets you change most attributes such as status, supplier, quantities, dates, prices, currencies, references, and logistics details. It also supports re-deriving purchase prices and related defaults. When the Retrieve new values option is activated, the service searches for a valid purchase price and automatically updates price, internal reference, delivery details, and other fields from current agreements and item/supplier data.
